metadata.case_name: YUSAF EDNAN v. LEIGHTON KUMUGAI JOINT VENTURE

injuries.description: fracture of the left tibia and fibula
source: He was there diagnosed with a fracture of the left tibia and fibula, with local tenderness and deformity of left tibia.

injuries.description: residual impairment of the function of the left tibia as a result of soft tissue scarring around the fracture site
source: There was a residual impairment of the function of the left tibia as a result of soft tissue scarring around the fracture site.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of lower leg, including ankle, unspecified

manifestations.description: pain in the left knee especially when he sits with his arm resting on the left knee.
he can only squat for a very short period of time
numbness and tingling sensation in the left leg
pain in the left leg when running
7 cm longitudinal scars over the left infra-patella area with four stab scars at the medical side of the shin
tenderness at the junction between the lower third and middle third of the tibia
slight tenderness in the Gerdy's tubercle and mild pain in the patellofemoral joint
a slight bony protruberance at the anterior aspect of the tibio-plateu corresponding to the insertion point of the tibial intramedullary nail
1.5cm muscle atrophy of the left calf and slight left thigh muscle atrophy
calcification around the site of insertion, suggesting irritation of the patella tendon
walks with a limp which becomes more pronounced the further he walked

treatments_received: close reduction and implant of intramedullary nail to his left leg
outpatient follow-up at Orthopaedics & Traumatology Department

losses.description: Continues to suffer pain exacerbated by walking and squatting and walks with a limp which becomes more pronounced the further he walks.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: His pre-accident sporting activities have necessarily had to be curtailed.
Not able to return to the specific type of employment (tunnel boring machine mechanic/fitter) which entails lifting and manoeuvring very heavy weights in confined spaces and over uneven surfaces.
